ops.cost.note: Measured 2026-10-21 with doctl over every App Platform app of the team: Orochia's dev deployment is one basic-xxs web app (5 USD) plus its share of the shared dev database (15 USD, counted once in the org total); the operator console is served by it on admin.orochia.com since the 2026-10-21 cutover (orochia#334), and the old app orochia-admin-dev (5 USD) is deleted from 2026-10-23T13:00Z after its 48 h rollback window. Organisation recurring cloud about 97 USD/month before and about 87 after both old admin apps are deleted (ceiling 100, GPU apart); the private cost table (§ 6.2) carries the same figures.

admin.noindex.note: After the cutover to orochia-dev, robots.txt answers 200 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' with X-Robots-Tag noindex for any address, before the IP gate (orochia#365, test first).

admin.operator-tasks.note: Operator tasks run on the real dev DB through the console (admin.orochia.com, from an allowed address), each audited with who, when, outcome and request id (audit screen: https://krizaka-assets.b-cdn.net/pr-assets/orochia/devpreview-admin-operator-tasks/audit.dark.desktop.png): content report triage as a persona's report (Mira Castellanos on a neutral video; start review then resolve with a reason); account suspend then reinstate of a demo account with reasons; app-version parameters as data: a refused publish (latest older than minimum, outcome refused), a publish (revision 2) and a rollback to revision 1 republished as a new revision (the admin API behind it was missing and shipped in orochia#366). The Tasks view (orochia#363) is the operator's queue derived from the platform counters and the audit: the refused publish appears as a task, the later success clears it (https://krizaka-assets.b-cdn.net/pr-assets/orochia/devpreview-admin-operator-tasks/tasks-2-cleared.dark.desktop.png). Not covered live: payouts, 2257 verification and takedown (covered by the console's unit tests; no payout request or unverified creator exists on dev) and a one-click retry.

admin.audit-log.note: The operator log shows who, what, target, area, outcome (ok / refused / failed), request id and detail, filterable and exportable (orochia#363, same shape as krizaka/orazaka ADR-085); every console action goes through attempt() with a log entry (console/lib/audit.test.ts). Earlier evidence: orochia-admin#57.

admin.shell.note: The console is the Krizaka UI shell: AppShell (sidebar, a drawer on a phone) with the DEV badge in the header and AuthLayout for the sign-in (orochia#364, test console/components/shell.test.ts). Live crawl 64/64 clean (16 screens x dark/light x desktop/phone, e2e/console-crawl.mjs, from an allowed address): DEV badge on every screen, one h1, no console error, no horizontal scroll. It found and fixed a hydration mismatch (orochia#367). Captures of the screens without account data are on Bunny under pr-assets/orochia/devpreview-admin-shell/.
